description: This file defines the ScreenCache class, which manages caching of widget outputs associated with screens in the OFBiz framework. It provides methods to get, put, and remove cached widget outputs based on screen name and cache keys.

classes.name: ScreenCache
classes.description: A cache management class for storing and retrieving widget outputs associated with screens in the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: ScreenCache
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the cache with the type 'screen'.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the cached widget output for a given screen name and cache key.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Stores a widget output in the cache for a specific screen name and cache key.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes and returns the cached widget output for a specific screen name and cache key, with verbose debug logging.
